entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Investigate and address RISC-V-specific JumpStub issues #135607
  • Runtime_134891 test failing in CI #135604
  • NativeAOT 11: branching on `AvxVnni.IsSupported` compiles to an infinite loop with `IlcInstructionSet=native` (Zen 4) #135603
  • JIT: a method whose first instruction is inside a finally or fault handler compiles and overflows the stack when called #135593
  • JIT: a filter clause nested in an earlier-listed handler fails with "Unexpected endfilter" (stale handler index after fgSortEHTable) #135592
  • [Linux x64] DAC SIGSEGV while enumerating stack roots on a live process #135590
  • [API Proposal]: AsyncLazy<T>: asynchronous lazy initialization #135589
  • Thread exit frees a stale thread-static LOADERHANDLE against the wrong (live) collectible LoaderAllocator #135588
  • NonBacktracking regex misses a match when word-boundary alternatives repeat #135586
  • regex NonBacktracking chooses a longer match than the backtracking engines #135585
  • Regex counted repetition of a greedy loop returns a too-short match #135584
  • QuicStream leaks its native QUIC_BUFFER array for every stream that sends data #135583
  • double.ToString("R") is not round-trippable for 2^-25 and 2^-958 on .NET 10 (regression from .NET 8) #135582

Closed

  • [API Proposal]: Array.Create<T> with default value and factory function #121477
    12.0.0

    area-CodeGen-coreclr

    area-CodeGen-coreclr

    area-CodeGen-coreclr

    area-CodeGen-coreclr
